purpose: Source-first inventory of every explicitly supported Zubaida session/group plus major source-internal structural subunits. This is additive navigation metadata; preserved source text remains canonical and unchanged.

source_contract.reply_chain_rule: Quoted reply-chain material is not counted as a new transmission or session.

boundary_contract.session_start: Only ZUB-001-validated source-body session-label locators are treated as direct session starts. Explicit grouped ranges remain grouped; no hidden per-session boundary is invented.
boundary_contract.subunit: Major explicitly formatted source headings are indexed as subordinate discoverability units using deterministic structural-heading rules; they are not promoted to sessions.
boundary_contract.ambiguity: Subject-level session-count claims without explicit body boundaries are retained as ambiguities, not fabricated session records.

session_reconciliation.result: The preserved corpus does not support 526 individually established Zubaida sessions.
session_reconciliation.interpretation: The difference is not filled by inference. The 526 figure may refer to a broader historical/chat corpus or a counting convention not preserved in these 118 source-bearing emails; this dataset records only what the preserved evidence supports.
